tables.name: wrap_schedule_defaults
tables.units: radius in mm; stiffness alpha relative to data term; distances in mm; angles in degrees
tables.population: design defaults for template-to-scan wrapping of adult faces
tables.notes: Annealing principle is sourced (decreasing stiffness and landmark weight); the numeric values are engineering choices consistent with import-export-scans and metahuman-cc-bridges notes. Reject correspondences beyond max(3*MAD, stage cap) or inside a 2-3 mm scan-boundary band.
